title: State Compliance Bulletin: Climate Uplift to the Package Electricity Allowance
content:
# Climate Uplift to the Electricity Allowance — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**Bulletin clause.** For the final electricity overage of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account, before proration the monthly electricity allowance is raised by a climate uplift set by the community's state as recorded on the Apartment Home Lease:

| State recorded on the lease | Climate uplift to the monthly allowance |
|---|---|
| AZ | 150 kWh |
| TX | 150 kWh |
| CA | 75 kWh |
| GA | 75 kWh |
| CO, WA or any other state | 0 kWh |

The raised monthly allowance is then prorated by the proration days over the days in period of the account's latest package fee line, to 3 decimals.

*Worked case (hypothetical monthly allowance of 600 kWh, 12 proration days over 30):* in TX the raised allowance is 750 kWh and the prorated allowance 300.000 kWh; in GA 675 kWh and 270.000 kWh; in CO 600 kWh and 240.000 kWh.
